cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll answer the caretaker about our extra key. We were checking the cake cupboard's lock; say that with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We did check it. Then we ate the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll keep the order straight: check the lock first. I'll explain the cake if he asks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll ask why there are crumbs in the lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we both remember a blockage. You describe the crumbs; I'll explain our maintenance.

reason: Give A a concrete rehearsal and division of explanation roles; A accepts B details into one maintenance version rather than merely announcing control.
